# sleep-aur 3.1.2

## Improvements

- The installer detects missing build dependencies on Arch Linux: `git`, `jq`, and the `base-devel` group.
- It asks for confirmation before installing them with `pacman`, and installs them automatically when accepted.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/the-sleepless/sleep-aur/compare/v3.1.1...v3.1.2
